source: BattleShips Pro v1.187 object data + JASS, multi-agent audit pass 2

upgrades.name: Tower Defense
upgrades.appliesTo: n004 Cannon Tower only (upgr='R001,R000'); tooltip calls these 'Empire Towers'. Researched at n00P Upgrade Center. Effect rhpx = flat HP bonus; 180s research per level.

upgrades.name: Tower Damage
upgrades.appliesTo: n004 Cannon Tower only (upgr='R001,R000'); effect ratx = flat attack-damage bonus restricted to weapon class 'artillery' (tower attack 20+10d2 artillery, avg 35). Researched at n00P; 180s per level. Tooltip's 'average of 13 per level' = total 130 averaged over 10 levels.

upgrades.name: Tower Mechanics Upgrade
upgrades.appliesTo: ORPHANED in object data: no unit lists R002 in Upgrades Used and it is absent from the Upgrade Center's (n00P) research list — unresearchable and ineffective as extracted. Tooltip claims it sets Main Harbor (n000, 20000 HP) regen to 20 HP/s. Effect rhpr = flat HP regen; 300s research.

levels.effect: +20 HP/s regeneration (tooltip: Main Harbor regen 'to 20'); inert per object data — verify against map triggers

upgrades.name: Ship Hull
upgrades.appliesTo: Imperial AI lane ships ONLY (h00I/h00E Rowboat 100 HP, h00B/h00F Battle Ship 400 HP, h00H/h00G Cruiser 1500 HP; upgr='R005,R003,R004'). Player ships unaffected. Effect rhpo = % of BASE max HP; 45s per level. Tooltip claims 250%/275% at L9/L10 — stale; objectdata gives 225%/250%.

upgrades.name: Ship Sails
upgrades.appliesTo: Imperial AI lane ships ONLY (upgr='R005,R003,R004'); despite the name it does NOT speed up player ships. Effect rmvx = flat movement speed; 30s per level.

upgrades.name: Ship Cannons
upgrades.appliesTo: Imperial AI lane ships ONLY (h00I/h00E Rowboat 3+2d3, h00B/h00F Battle Ship 9+2d8, h00H/h00G Cruiser 24+2d14; missile weapons, matching class restriction 'ranged'). It does NOT modify player item-weapon damage: player ships lack the upgr reference and item weapons deal ability (spell) damage immune to attack upgrades — see notes. Effect ratd = bonus attack DICE; each bonus die adds 1..(unit's own sides per die) damage per attack (rowboat 1-3, battleship 1-8, cruiser 1-14). Objectdata base=1 mod=8 -> +1 die at L1 then +8 dice/level (anomalous); tooltip claims a flat +1 die/level (and stale 'Cruisers 1-12'). 45s per level.
